title: Dallas Police Officers Fire on Suspect Pointing Replica Gun
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Dallas, Texas — On January 7, 2025 at approximately 3:15 p.m., the Dallas Police Department received six 9-1-1 calls regarding a suspect pointing a gun at vehicles as they drove by him on Joaquin Drive. Witness described the suspect, later identified as 52-year-old Michael Alonzo, wearing a red hoodie and gray sweatpants. Officers Lopez-Navarro and Nathaniel Cairns, arrived at approximately 3:21 p.m. and observed Alonzo wearing a red hoodie and gray sweatpants, standing in the street in the 11000 block of Joaquin Drive. Alonzo is observed pointing a handgun at a person inside a vehicle that was pulling over. The Officers gave Alonzo verbal commands in English and Spanish which he ignored. 

Officer Lopez-Navarro is heard saying he's got a gun in his hand. After additional verbal commands Officer Cairns states "he's pointing it, he's pointing it", resulting in both Officers discharging the firearms striking Alonzo. Both Officers immediately provided first aid to Alonzo until Dallas Fire Rescue's arrival. He was transported to a local hospital, where he remains in stable but critical condition. Alonzo's weapon was recovered at the scene and was later determined to be a replica firearm, specifically a Crossman Revolver CO2 Air Pistol. Alonzo will be charged with, three counts of deadly conduct and additional charges may follow. Alonzo’s previous criminal history includes arrests for prostitution and theft by check. No Officers or any other persons were injured during this incident.
